marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Petty, you are so cool!. season 2

Synopsis : Far away, on a snow-covered island, there is a small village inside a forest where a group of animals lived. There's Pororo, the inquisitive and playful penguin; Crong, the naughty little dinosaur; the good-natured polar bear, Poby; the proud and nosy red fox, Eddy;and the gentle beaver, Loopy. And in season two, we have new friends, Petty, Harry and a few more fascinating characters joining the bunch! As usual, the friends are never short of troubles, but their great friendship and genuine care for each other overcome it all.
